research.title: Image Preprocessing for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned image resizing, grayscale normalization, and patch extraction routines for surface defect classification using an established preprocessing specification.
Checked processed samples against annotation files and documented mismatched labels and boundary handling issues for review within the existing experimental workflow.

work.title: Order Processing and Inventory Coordination
bullets: Processed incoming order paperwork, checked item descriptions against stock records, and routed incomplete requests to the appropriate staff for clarification.
Maintained filing records, coordinated routine delivery appointments, and reconciled shipment documents with received goods before forwarding discrepancies for follow-up.

projects.title: Baseline Scene Classification with Color and Texture Features
bullets: Implemented a scene classification baseline using color histograms, local binary pattern features, and a support vector machine with standardized feature inputs.
Evaluated predictions on a held-out image split using confusion matrices and inspected misclassified examples for lighting variation and visually similar scene categories.
